answers.note: MediaBox задаёт границы физического носителя, на котором страницу отображают или печатают.
CropBox задаёт видимую область; при отображении или печати содержимое страницы обрезают по этой границе. Если CropBox не задан, используют MediaBox.
TrimBox задаёт предполагаемые размеры готовой страницы после обрезки. Если он не задан, стандарт указывает значение CropBox.
BleedBox задаёт область, до которой содержимое страницы обрезают при выводе в производственной среде.

card.explanation: TrimBox задаёт предполагаемые размеры готовой страницы после обрезки; если он не задан, стандарт указывает CropBox. MediaBox описывает границы физического носителя, CropBox — видимую область, а BleedBox — границу обрезки содержимого при выводе в производственной среде.
card.prompt: В PDF для печати какую границу страницы задают как предполагаемый размер готовой страницы после обрезки?

source.title: PDF 32000-1:2008 — PDF 1.7, Adobe authorized copy of ISO 32000-1:2008

answers.note: Контейнер EPUB 3.3 основан на ZIP и может включать структуру публикации и связанные ресурсы, а не только текст.
Дерево страниц определяет порядок страниц в PDF. Его конечные узлы — объекты Page, каждый из которых задаёт атрибуты отдельной страницы.
DAISY DTB может содержать полный текст и аудио с синхронизацией; существуют также DTB с текстом, но без аудио.
В руководстве Kindle перечислены .AZW и .AZW1; Mobipocket .MOBI/.PRC допускаются только без DRM.

card.explanation: В руководстве Kindle формат AZW указан отдельно от файлов Mobipocket. Для чтения Mobipocket на устройстве руководство требует, чтобы файлы MOBI или PRC не были защищены DRM.

В OCF-контейнере EPUB файл mimetype должен быть первым и не сжатым; сам контейнер основан на ZIP.

card.prompt: Какой формат электронного документа обычно сохраняет расположение текста и графики в заданной геометрии страницы?

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a barcode pattern; peer entity is a PDF page-boundary box.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks what a scanner-readable bars-and-spaces representation is called; peer asks which boundary denotes the expected finished page size after trimming.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Штрихкод; peer key: TrimBox. Neither is an answer to the other.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Barcode/GS1 encoding versus print-production geometry inside PDF page dictionaries.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: The target does not ask for a PDF page box; the peer does not ask for a machine-readable pattern.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a barcode pattern; peer entity is a digital book format.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks the name of an optical-scanner-readable bars-and-spaces pattern; peer asks which format a specific Kindle guide lists separately from non-DRM Mobipocket files.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Штрихкод; peer key: AZW.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Machine-readable representation versus Kindle file-format classification in a 2004–2007 guide.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: The barcode question does not ask for an ebook format, and AZW does not name a bars-and-spaces pattern.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a Halifax borrower card/account credential; peer entity is a PDF page boundary.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks which credential links loans to a reader account; peer asks which PDF box defines finished trimmed page size.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Читательский билет; peer key: TrimBox.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Library circulation and borrower-account tracking versus document page geometry for print.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: A reader card cannot specify PDF trim size, and TrimBox cannot link materials to a library account.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a library borrower credential/account relation; peer entity is an ebook format.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks which Halifax credential links checked-out materials to a reader account; peer asks which Kindle format is listed separately from Mobipocket files.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Читательский билет; peer key: AZW.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Public-library circulation versus historical Kindle file compatibility.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: A library card is not AZW, and AZW does not identify a library borrower.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target concerns a publisher’s publication copy and a library deposit system; peer concerns a PDF page boundary.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks the name of the publisher-to-library deposit regime; peer asks the boundary for intended finished page size after trimming.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Обязательный экземпляр; peer key: TrimBox.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Legal deposit across UK/Ireland publication and library delivery versus print-production geometry within a PDF.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: Neither the deposit obligation nor delivery copy names a PDF box; TrimBox does not name a deposit system.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a publisher’s publication copy under a library-deposit system; peer entity is an ebook file format.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks the name of the publication-deposit regime; peer asks which format appears in a Kindle manual’s format list.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: Обязательный экземпляр; peer key: AZW.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Publisher legal obligation to deposit publications versus file-format naming in a device manual.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: The legal-deposit regime is not AZW, while AZW does not name a publisher delivery obligation.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a continuing serial title/resource; peer entity is a page-box boundary in a PDF document.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks which number identifies a serial publication; peer asks which boundary specifies finished page dimensions after trimming.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: ISSN; peer key: TrimBox.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Serial-resource identification versus PDF print layout.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: ISSN does not specify page trim geometry, and TrimBox is not a serial identifier.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a continuing serial publication/title; peer entity is an ebook format.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks the identifier for a continuing serial; peer asks which Kindle file format the guide distinguishes from non-DRM Mobipocket.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: ISSN; peer key: AZW.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Serial publication identification versus Kindle file-format naming.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: ISSN does not identify the requested Kindle format, and AZW does not identify a serial title.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a DOI-identified referent; peer entity is a PDF page boundary.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks which identifier agencies assign and use in research; peer asks which PDF box defines the finished page size after trim.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: DOI; peer key: TrimBox.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Persistent identification across physical/digital/abstract objects versus print geometry.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: DOI does not describe a PDF boundary, and TrimBox is not an identifier assigned by a registration agency.

meaningfulBilateralMAIN.entity: The target entity is a DOI referent; peer entity is an ebook format.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.relation: Target asks the identifier assigned by registration agencies and used in scholarly publication; peer asks which file format the Kindle guide lists separately from Mobipocket.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.value: Target key: DOI; peer key: AZW.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.context: Identifier assignment and referent resolution versus a Kindle file format in a historical device guide.
meaningfulBilateralMAIN.directAndReverse: DOI is not the requested Kindle format, and AZW is not a persistent identifier assigned by a registration agency.
